name: smwgraphics-nangoku-shounen-papuwa-kun-uiror-land-pachinko
title: Nangoku Shounen Papuwa-kun - Uiror Land (Pachinko)
description:
A tropical city background seen in the pachinko stage of Nangoku Shounen Papuwa-kun. In the original game, parallax scrolling is used to give some depth to it.

Can fit various kind of stages, such as a city or even a carnival-themed level.
